name: How We Feel
one_liner: Free, ad-free emotion journal from a nonprofit, made with Yale's Center for Emotional Intelligence: name your feelings and try short coping strategies.
best_for: People who want to get better at noticing and naming their emotions
Anyone who wants a free mood journal with no ads or subscription
Teens and adults learning simple emotion-regulation skills
People who want journal entries kept on their phone without making an account
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People looking for treatment of depression, anxiety or another diagnosed condition
People who want a therapist, coach or structured program inside the app
short_description: A free emotion journal from a nonprofit, made with Yale emotion scientists: check in on how you feel, spot patterns and try short strategies.
long_description: How We Feel is a free emotion journal made by The How We Feel Project, a nonprofit, with a science team led by Marc Brackett of the Yale Center for Emotional Intelligence; it grew out of the earlier Mood Meter app. You check in by picking the word that best fits how you feel from a colour-coded map, add notes or tags, and over time see patterns, including with sleep and exercise if you connect Apple Health. Short video strategies suggest ways to shift or manage a feeling, and you can share check-ins with friends you choose. It has no ads or subscription. Its privacy notice says it does not sell personal information or use it for ads; without an account, what you log stays on your phone, and research sharing is opt-in and anonymised. Optional AI features send check-in details to a service provider. No published study of the app itself was found, so it is a self-help journal rather than a treatment.
patient_summary: You check in by choosing the word that fits how you feel, add a note if you like, and the app suggests short strategies and shows patterns over time. It is free with no ads, made by a nonprofit with Yale emotion researchers. You can use it without an account, and then your entries stay on your phone.

pricing.notes: Free with no ads, subscription or in-app purchases; made by a nonprofit.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell personal information or use it for ads. Without an account nothing personal is collected and entries stay on your phone; an optional account, opt-in anonymised research sharing and optional AI features send data off the device.

faqs.q: How much does How We Feel cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with How We Feel before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can How We Feel replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. How We Feel is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use How We Feel?
faqs.a: How We Feel is available on iPhone and Android.

faqs.q: What does How We Feel include?
faqs.a: Emotion check-ins with a colour-coded map; Short video regulation strategies; Patterns with sleep and exercise (HealthKit); Share feelings with trusted friends; English and Spanish.
